The formal definition is in Chap 3.9.5.2.1.1 of the S1000D specification and in the [S1000D Issue 7 data dictionary](https://users.s1000d.org/S1000D_DD_7/Files/attributes/updateHighlight.xml).
:::

`updateHighlight` is the attribute that states whether a reason for update (`reasonForUpdate`) appears in the highlights data module. It is optional.

## Elements that carry it

In the 33 XML schemas of Issue 7, 1 element carries this attribute.

| Element | Schemas | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `reasonForUpdate` | 25 | Optional |

## Allowed values

The allowed values are decided by the XML schema. The default BREX (Business Rules Exchange) has no rule that lists the values of this attribute.

| Defined by | Content |
| --- | --- |
| XML schema | The type is `yesOrNoAttType` (based on `xs:int`). The pattern is `[01]` |

## Meaning of the values

| Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `1` | The reason for update appears in the highlights data module |
| `0` | The reason for update does not appear in the highlights data module |

## In this stack

| Operation | Tool |
| --- | --- |
| Read | [`read_data_module`](/s1000d-stack/reference/stack/reader/read-data-module/). `updateHighlight` is in `identAndStatus.reasonForUpdates[]` |
| Write it together with a reason for update | `reason.updateHighlight` of [`add_reason_for_update`](/s1000d-stack/reference/stack/writer/add-reason-for-update/) and [`start_revision`](/s1000d-stack/reference/stack/writer/start-revision/), and `marking.reason.updateHighlight` of [`edit_data_module`](/s1000d-stack/reference/stack/writer/edit-data-module/) |

No tool chooses the value. The value to pass is `"0"` or `"1"`, and it can be omitted.
